mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 3.8% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 3.8%, or Rank IC falls below -0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction that triggers corporate revenue revisions downward, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >0.5% from prior month, or Rank IC is below 0.01 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production slowdowns (INDPRO decline), manufacturing sector weakness amplifies supply chain disruptions, reducing corporate profitability and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declines for two consecutive months, or Rank IC is negative over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three months indicates robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS increases for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 2.5% year-over-year, it signals accelerating inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% y/y, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicate monetary tightening that raises discount rates and erodes real corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises >0.25pp and CPIAUCSL rises >0.5pp from prior month, or Rank IC is below 0.01 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle slowdowns (GDPC1 < 2.0% annualized), weak consumer demand (RSAFS growth < 0.5%) triggers significant corporate earnings revisions downward, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 < 2.0% and RSAFS growth < 0.5%, or Rank IC is negative over 2-year rolling window.
